txns.gain_basis: DERIVED vs_valuation (acquisition discount): (purchase price S$140.3m - appraised value S$143.8m) / S$143.8m = -2.43%. Not disclosed as a %. Appraised value on acquisition by Knight Frank Pte Ltd (capitalisation, DCF and direct comparison methods). Portfolio Statement valuation as at 30 Sep 2025 = S$145.0m (would be +3.35% vs purchase price if used instead).
txns.verbatim: Acquisition table (p37): 'Property 2 Tuas South Link 1 | Appraised Value on Acquisition $143.8 million (Knight Frank Pte Ltd, based on the capitalisation, discounted cash flow and direct comparison methods) | Purchase Price $140.3 million'. Portfolio Statement (p175): '2 Tuas South Link 1 | 5 November 2024 | 30-year leasehold expiring 2 August 2046 | 145,000'. Narrative: 'In November 2024, we completed the acquisition ... purchased from Diamond Land Pte. Ltd.' sale_price field holds the SGD purchase price (this is an acquisition, not a sale); no carrying_value / gain / net proceeds applicable. valuation_date null: the S$143.8m appraisal is dated 'on acquisition' (~Nov 2024) with no explicit 'as at' date.

txns.gain_basis: DERIVED vs_valuation from audited Divestment table (p37): (consideration A$192.1m - appraised A$191.0m) / A$191.0m = +0.58%. Independent valuation by Savills Valuations Pty Ltd (capitalisation and DCF methods), as at 1 Jun 2025 (~S$160.4m). vs_book_value alt: gain_on_divestment S$180k on carrying value S$162,052k = +0.11% (P&L-recognised gain, group SGD accounts).
